description: What the weather is usually like in a city or at any point on a given day of the year, from the ERA5 climate archive 2021–2025 (median of 35 archive days: the date ±3 days over five years): day and night temperature, on how many of the 35 days there was precipitation, the usual sky, sea or large-lake water temperature, solar radiation for panels and the VanSky climate index; plus all 12 months and the best month to travel. Climate, not a forecast. Use it for dates beyond the coming week ("weather in Batumi in mid-September", "is the sea warm in Antalya in May") and for "when is the best time to go"; for today and this week use get_city_travel_weather. Omit date to get the month overview.

city.description: City or town name in any language, e.g. Batumi, Antalya. Omit when passing lat and lng.

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code to disambiguate the city (Barcelona ES vs Barcelona VE).

date.description: Day of the year, MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DD (the year is ignored), e.g. 09-18. Omit for an overview of all 12 months and the best month.

lat.description: Latitude of any point, instead of a city.

lng.description: Longitude of any point, instead of a city.

locale.description: Language the user writes in (en, ru, de, fr, es, pt, tr). Set it on every call: the answer and the interactive card are shown in this language and units; without it the card falls back to the app's interface language.

name: get_city_climate
title: Typical Weather On Any Date
